trigger: Dusk, Day 60. Knock at the back door. Only if trust.wren >= 3.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Don't open it all the way. Cold. Also I'm not here.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Don't sleep tonight, Sparky. The garage across the alley. You get me?

choices.text: The Bridge Boys are hitting Ray?

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Because I'm the one who walked by it twice and counted cans. Okay? Happy?

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Can't. If I'm warm they'll smell it on me. Ha. Kidding. Mostly.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Midnight-ish. Six guys. They're not evil, they're just cold and Ray's got a lot.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: Except the Guard took Ray's diesel last week. Somebody told. Boys don't know yet.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: They're gonna find nothing. They hate finding nothing.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: I owed you. Now we're even. Don't make it weird.
